compounding_issues: All 5 sessions aborted before doing any work — each .instrument/session_N.jsonl contains only 'You've hit your session limit' with 0 input/output tokens, so no agent code was ever generated
The commit labels (greenfield, feature_addition, integration, refactor, cross_cutting) describe an intended arc that never materialized — every commit only appends an empty session log, not code

Seed itself contains latent defects that would have compounded had sessions run — createTask inserts status 'done' while returning 'pending', and a legacy notifyAdmin helper plus dead fetchTask wrapper remain
key_decisions: None — no architectural decisions were made because the agent never produced a single edit in any session (session-limit gate blocked all runs)

story_review.trajectory_description: Quality is flat at zero: the codebase never changed from the initial seed. Session 1 through session 5 each hit the provider session-limit error before emitting any tokens, so the commits are placeholder artifacts recording instrumentation metadata rather than incremental implementation. There is no greenfield build, no feature addition, no integration, no refactor, and no cross-cutting work to evaluate — the arc exists only in commit-message labels.
story_review.summary: A degenerate story run: all five sessions aborted on a session-limit error before doing any work, leaving an untouched seed and five commits that contain only empty session logs.
